clips.send: Can a staircase fool your eyes? Can falling blocks keep a beat? Look closely at how games use color, sound and rules, then try making something of your own.
clips.text: Can a staircase fool your eyes? Can falling blocks keep a beat? Look closely at how games use color, sound and rules, then try making something of your own.

clips.send: Pastel towers and stairways seem to meet in midair. The team drew on M. C. Escher’s impossible architecture, turning a trick of perspective into a path you can walk.
clips.text: Pastel towers and stairways seem to meet in midair. The team drew on M. C. Escher’s impossible architecture, turning a trick of perspective into a path you can walk.

clips.send: Pick a note, then tap a step to place it. Leave a rest for a little breathing room. Play the same notes with a square wave and a triangle wave. How does the sound quality, or timbre, change?
clips.text: Pick a note, then tap a step to place it. Leave a rest for a little breathing room. Play the same notes with a square wave and a triangle wave. How does the sound quality, or timbre, change?

clips.send: Turn falling shapes until they fit and a full row vanishes. In this edition, sounds and particles respond as you play, so placing a piece can feel like adding a beat to the music.
clips.text: Turn falling shapes until they fit and a full row vanishes. In this edition, sounds and particles respond as you play, so placing a piece can feel like adding a beat to the music.

clips.send: From the aligned view, the centers of the two end cubes land on the same spot on screen. The ends look joined. Turn the 3D model to see where they come apart.
clips.text: From the aligned view, the centers of the two end cubes land on the same spot on screen. The ends look joined. Turn the 3D model to see where they come apart.

clips.send: Two matching small fruits can merge into a bigger fruit. The round shapes and simple faces make the fruits easy to tell apart, even when a single drop starts a chain of bounces and merges.
clips.text: Two matching small fruits can merge into a bigger fruit. The round shapes and simple faces make the fruits easy to tell apart, even when a single drop starts a chain of bounces and merges.

clips.send: Everyday things become little still lifes as you sort and line them up. Some puzzles have several solutions, which makes arranging objects by shape or size feel like finding a new pattern.
clips.text: Everyday things become little still lifes as you sort and line them up. Some puzzles have several solutions, which makes arranging objects by shape or size feel like finding a new pattern.

clips.send: Your player is looking for lost seeds in a garden. Choose a clue or a retry rule to help them find their way. Then pick the lighting and something that lets them slow down.
clips.text: Your player is looking for lost seeds in a garden. Choose a clue or a retry rule to help them find their way. Then pick the lighting and something that lets them slow down.

clips.send: Tap or drag on the 16 times 16 grid and watch the enlarged preview. Can you redraw the sprout with just three colors and still make it easy to recognize?
clips.text: Tap or drag on the 16 × 16 grid and watch the enlarged preview. Can you redraw the sprout with just three colors and still make it easy to recognize?

clips.send: Rotate hexagonal tiles to build a landscape. A river on one tile can continue into the next, and patches of forest and fields gradually make a picture bigger than any one piece.
clips.text: Rotate hexagonal tiles to build a landscape. A river on one tile can continue into the next, and patches of forest and fields gradually make a picture bigger than any one piece.

clips.send: Look at how the warm colors and hand-drawn faces make the shop feel welcoming. Try picturing a pizza with toppings scattered everywhere, then one with toppings in rings. How does the arrangement change where you look first?

clips.send: 把日常小物件分类、排整齐，就摆出了一幅幅静物画。有些谜题有多种解法，按形状或大小换个排法，就可能发现新的规律。

clips.send: 玩家要找回花园里的种子。选一种能帮玩家辨路的提示或重试规则，再挑一组光线和一个让人放松的设计。

clips.send: 两个相同的小水果碰在一起，可以合成一个更大的水果。圆圆的轮廓和简单的表情各有特点，就算一个水果落下，引起接连的弹跳和合并，也容易分清。

clips.send: 转动下落的方块，把一整行填满，那一行就会消失。这个版本的音效和光点会随操作变化，落下一块就像给音乐添上一拍。
